question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

One who feeds on plants only
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 4' **i.e. **'Herbivorous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• For the question "One who feeds on plants only", the answer is** Herbivorous.**
 
• **Herbivorous** refers to an organism that eats only plants.(शाकाहारी)

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: **'Herbivorous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vermivorous** (कीटभक्षी) refers to organisms that eat worms.
 
• **Carnivorous** (मांसाहारी) refers to organisms that eat meat.
 
• **Omnivorous **(सर्वाहारी) refers to organisms that eat both plants and meat.
